channel.title: Counterwise guides (working name)
channel.description: Question-shaped buying guides for air fryers and kitchen appliances.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Working title. The two formats differ in shape, not in promise. Start with how you cook, then read what each listing says.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity is easy to misread. This checklist keeps you on the figures the listings state.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Cleanup and counter space decide whether a kitchen appliance gets used. Both are easy to check before you buy.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function appliances promise many jobs. Ask which jobs you will do every week, and what each one costs in space and cleaning.

item.title: Do you need a meat thermometer if you own an air fryer?
item.description: Air fryers brown the outside before the inside is done. A thermometer is the only way to know which happened.
